notes_for_us: A genre file's Typical shapes line gives Type (Flavor Name) but not the shape's pipeline modifier, so I had to open shapes.md to emit `pipeline` even though interior-single fit fine. The claim that a fitting typical shape needs no catalogue read only holds for the name, not the route.

Take-the-whole-preset put social-hub into a gallery the prompt calls 'your' gallery. It is not contradicted so it does not qualify as preset_rejected, but a gathering area is a real instruction to the image model and nothing in the prompt asked for one.

notes_for_us: Nothing in the skill network says what to do with a prompt written in another language. Classification was fine, but 'take the ID and write the words from the prompt' cannot be followed literally when the prompt's words are Arabic, so every text field is my English paraphrase and the user's phrasing survives nowhere.

The word 'shop' fails the same way in a dozen prompts: building-interior and a GUI storefront are both plausible and they route differently (P3 versus nothing). There is no rule for which to assume, so this decision is being made differently by every reader.

'Exactly like minigame games' selected a preset without ever naming an activity, so the preset filled the whole build. The result looks complete on paper and is unbuildable in fact — the stage has no content. Worth a rule that a staged shape with no named round activity is insufficient rather than partial.
